name: March 4, 2025 Special Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu City Council
  Special Meeting

Please take notice that the Special City Council Meeting of Tuesday, March 4, 2025,
is hereby adjourned to Wednesday, March 5, 2025, at 3:00 p.m.

The Adjourned Special meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City Hall,
23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the City Clerk’s
Office at cityclerk@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 228.

  NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE

Public hearings scheduled for the March 4, 2025 City Council meeting are hereby
continued to the March 5, 2025 Adjourned Special City Council meeting,
including:

Local Coastal Program Amendment No. 25-001 and Zoning Text Amendment No.
25-001 – An amendment to the Malibu Local Coastal Program and Malibu
Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning) Modifying Standards and Procedures to Facilitate
the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed by the 2025 Palisades Fire, 2024
Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire

Dated: March 4, 2025 at 9:15 p.m.

__________________________________
Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk
